name: Hoxie House

dates.altered: Restored 1959 after the town of Sandwich acquired it; re-shingled in cedar in 2008 (Wikipedia).
dates.note: The Wikipedia infobox prints 'Completed c. 1675 (MACRIS)', which the node's exemplar shares. Wikipedia's text says the house was built in the mid-seventeenth century and occupied around 1675 by the Rev. John Smith.

refs.title: Hoxie House - Wikipedia
refs.note: The infobox describes it as 'a 2.5-story half house with an integral rear lean-to' at 16 Water Street and carries no NRHP block, so no register reference is recorded.

note: No HABS survey was found: the loc.gov search '"Hoxie House" Sandwich HABS MA Water Street' returned unrelated items. No register reference was found either; the Wikipedia article cites MACRIS, which was not opened.
